main_body: autumn tree with clustered canopy and trunk
top_band: upper canopy leaf clumps in bright orange/amber tones (rows 1-24) lit from above
evidence: Organic tree shows overhead-lit canopy volume on top (rows 1-24) overhanging a shaded lower canopy underside (rows 28-33) and vertical trunk below (rows 31-45).

style.evidence: While the palette has 5-6 orange/brown steps and dark material outlines, the canopy is built from smooth, rounded pillow-like blobs (4-6px wide smooth bands) rather than the fine per-leaf cluster texture and intricate root/branch structure of the Beodeul reference trees. The trunk is also a simple straight tube compared to the gnarled, textured reference trunks.
